ADMIN_SUPPORT.FAQ_ADD_STUDENT_QUESTION: How do I add a new student?
ADMIN_SUPPORT.FAQ_ADD_STUDENT_ANSWER: Go to CRM & Students → Students → select “Add Student” at the top right.
ADMIN_SUPPORT.FAQ_BRANCH_QUESTION: Can I change my assigned Library Branch?
ADMIN_SUPPORT.FAQ_BRANCH_ANSWER: Only SuperAdmin can change branch assignments. Please create a Support Ticket.
ADMIN_SUPPORT.FAQ_FEES_ANSWER: Navigate to Finance → Collect Fee. Select the student and choose the payment method.
ADMIN_SUPPORT.FAQ_SUSPEND_ANSWER: Suspending a student temporarily blocks their access without deleting their records.
